fields.options:
Salary Component Based
Fixed Hourly Rate
fields.description:
Choose how the hourly overtime amount is calculated:
  1. Fixed Hourly Rate: A fixed, manually entered hourly rate.
  2. Salary Component-Based: (Sum of selected component amounts) ÷ (Payment Days) ÷ (Standard Daily Hours)

fields.label: Applicable Salary Components
fields.description: Select the salary components whose total will be used from the salary slip to calculate the hourly overtime rate.

fields.label: Pay Rate Multipliers
fields.description: Multipliers that adjust the hourly overtime amount for specific scenarios

fields.label: Apply for Public Holiday
fields.description: Enable this to use a specific multiplier for public holidays. If unchecked, the standard multiplier will be used instead.

fields.label: Apply for Weekend
fields.description: Enable this to use a specific multiplier for weekends. If unchecked, the standard multiplier will be used instead.
